=You are {{ $('Configuration').item.json.business_name }} customer support assistant on WhatsApp. You help customers with clear, friendly, concise answers.

HOW TO ANSWER:
- ALWAYS call the "Company knowledge base" tool first to look up the answer before replying. Base your answer only on what you find there.
- Reply in {{ $('Configuration').item.json.reply_language }}. Keep it short and easy to read on a phone screen.
- Never invent policies, prices, or facts that are not in the knowledge base.

WHEN TO ESCALATE TO A HUMAN:
- If the knowledge base does not contain the answer, OR the customer explicitly asks to talk to a person, OR the request involves a complaint, refund, cancellation, or anything you are unsure about: call the "Escalate to human support" tool to email the support team. In that tool, include the customer question, the customer phone number ({{ $('Configuration').item.json.customer_phone }}), and why it needs a human.
- After escalating, reply to the customer with exactly this message: {{ $('Configuration').item.json.escalation_notice }}

Always stay polite and professional.

parameters.content:
# Answer WhatsApp support chats from a Pinecone knowledge base with human escalation
# 📥  [Open full documentation on Notion](https://automatisation.notion.site/3b73d6550fd9811ba6e9d33642c2fcab)

## How it works
A customer messages your WhatsApp Business number. The AI Support Agent searches your Pinecone knowledge base (embeddings by Google Gemini) and answers only from that verified content, so it never invents a policy or a price. If it cannot find the answer, or the customer asks for a human, or the request is a complaint, refund or cancellation, the agent emails your support team and tells the customer that a person will follow up. The reply goes back over WhatsApp, and the conversation is remembered per phone number.

Canvas map, left to right:
1. Receive the message & configure
2. AI support agent (RAG + escalation)
3. Reply on WhatsApp

## Setup
1. Select your WhatsApp credentials on **WhatsApp Trigger** and **Send WhatsApp reply** (same phone number).
2. Select your OpenRouter credential on **OpenRouter Chat Model**.
3. Create a Pinecone credential and an index, load your FAQ and policy documents into it, then select that index on **Company knowledge base**.
4. Select your Google Gemini credential on **Gemini Embeddings**. The embedding model must match the one used to load your documents, otherwise the search returns nothing.
5. Select your Gmail credential on **Escalate to human support**.
6. Open **Configuration** and set `business_name`, `support_email`, `chat_model` and `reply_language`.

## Requirements
- A WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta) account with a phone number.
- An OpenRouter API key.
- A Pinecone account with an index already populated with your support content.
- A Google Gemini API key for the embeddings.
- A Gmail account to receive the escalation emails.

## Customization
- Every adjustable value lives in **Configuration**: models, reply language, support email, Top-K, memory window and the escalation notice sent to the customer.
- Change `chat_model` to any OpenRouter model id to swap the brain without touching a node.
- Tune how eagerly the bot escalates by editing the system message of **AI Support Agent**.
- Raise `knowledge_top_k` if answers feel incomplete, lower it if the agent drifts off topic.

The agent answers from your knowledge base only, but it is still an AI: review the escalation emails to see what it could not handle.

## 1. Receive the message & configure
The trigger fires on incoming WhatsApp messages. **Configuration** centralises every setting: models, support email, reply language, memory window. The filter keeps only real text messages, so a status update or an empty payload never wakes the agent.

## 2. AI support agent (RAG + escalation)
The agent searches the Pinecone knowledge base through the Gemini embeddings, remembers the conversation per phone number, and answers only from what it finds. When it cannot answer, or the customer asks for a person, it emails the support team instead of improvising.

## 3. Reply on WhatsApp
The agent's answer is sent back to the customer on the same WhatsApp number.
